sources.headline: Parte médico de Endrick
sources.summary: Official medical bulletin confirming that following tests carried out on November 23 on player Endrick by Real Madrid Medical Services, he was diagnosed with an injury to the abductor muscle of his left leg. The bulletin states his recovery is pending evolution and gives no official return date or recovery timetable.

sources.headline: El equipo se está entrenando
sources.summary: Official training report from Ciudad Real Madrid documenting team training on November 23. Confirms that Endrick worked indoors inside the facilities and did not participate in normal outdoor squad drills on that date.

sources.headline: La oferta del Milan por Endrick es firme: 70 millones de euros para llevárselo en invierno
sources.summary: Cadena SER reports that AC Milan presented a formal offer close to €70 million to sign Endrick in the winter transfer window. Recorded as a reported formal offer; does not claim Real Madrid accepted it or that a deal was completed.

sources.headline: La tentadora oferta del Milan al Real Madrid por Endrick: setenta kilos por el futbolista 19 o 20 de la plantilla es para tener en cuenta
sources.summary: Cadena SER reports separately that Milan would reportedly be willing to offer around €70 million, while José Mourinho reportedly opposes Endrick's departure to protect squad depth.

sources.headline: Tentazione Endrick: il Milan mette sul tavolo oltre 60 milioni, ma Mourinho...
sources.summary: November 16 Corriere dello Sport report detailing Milan putting over €60 million on the table plus potential additional bonuses, and referencing an €80 million buy-back figure.

sources.headline: Milan prepare €70m offer for Endrick
sources.summary: Relays TNT Sports Brazil reporting on Milan preparing an offer and mentions an €85 million buy-back figure. Kept distinct as a separate reported figure, with no agreed clause between clubs.

claims.text: Endrick is 20 years old, born on July 21, 2006.
Real Madrid officially confirmed on November 23, 2026 an injury to the abductor muscle of his left leg, pending evolution, with no official return date.
Real Madrid official training report on November 23 confirmed Endrick trained inside the facilities (indoors) and did not participate in normal outdoor squad drills.
Cadena SER reported on November 23 that Milan presented a formal offer close to €70 million. Recorded as a reported formal offer; Real Madrid have not accepted it.
Cadena SER reported on November 24 that Milan would reportedly be willing to offer around €70 million, but Mourinho reportedly opposes Endrick's departure.
Corriere dello Sport reported on November 16 a proposal of €60 million fixed plus potential bonuses, referencing an €80 million buy-back figure.
TNT Sports Brazil (relayed by MilanReports on November 18) cited an €85 million buy-back figure; recorded separately from the €80 million Italian figure, with no agreed clause.

editorial_brief.current_status: Injured (left-leg muscle injury, no official return date; trained indoors Nov 23) / Active squad member under José Mourinho
editorial_brief.ser_nov23_report: Reported formal offer close to €70M (unaccepted by Real Madrid)
editorial_brief.ser_nov24_report: Milan reportedly willing to offer around €70M; Mourinho reportedly opposes departure
editorial_brief.corriere_nov16_report: €60M fixed plus potential bonuses; €80M buy-back figure cited
editorial_brief.official_injury_bulletin: Abductor muscle of the left leg (Nov 23); pending evolution; no official return date; trained indoors
